This land is not mine — I rent it, so I do not want to pour too much money into it. Beans do not need as much fertilizer as maize, and last season I saw my neighbor's cowpea do well with just a small touch of NPK at planting, so I will do the same — maybe half a bag on this plot. I cannot afford improved seed this year, so I will use the seed I saved from last harvest, and I will spray once against the pod-sucking bugs because without spray the cowpea pods come out empty. My husband and children will help me weed, but at planting and harvest I will need to hire a few hands.
